snippet.title: Elsewar Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Elsewar is a fantasy roguelike deck builder about creating powerful synergies and mitigating the attrition of fighting Monsters with your Army of varied Units.
Available now on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4629760/Elsewar/
